newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW says seeking to boost return on sales.
newsitem.headline: VW says seeking to boost return on sales.

text.p: The chief financial officer of Volkswagen AG said on Thursday he believed the German carmaker could achieve a return on sales of between 6.5 and eight percent at the start of the next century.
VW chief financial officer Bruno Adelt made the statement at the group's annual general meeting.

VW's current return on sales is about two percent. The carmaker expects a better return on sales in 1997 but one official said the results would be burdened by the introduction of the new Skoda Octavia.
VW chief executive Ferdinand Piech has set 6.5 percent as a goal for the carmaker's return on sales.
